command.targetState: required only for correct: pending | taken | skipped (never missed)
command.administrationAmount: optional administration amount (take and correct only); stock counted in a unit loses exactly this amount, a plain count loses one
command.recordedBy: optional {version: 1, name: string 1-100 trimmed | null}; the display name the dose was recorded under (take, skip, undo, correct; never miss). Sent only to a server that advertises contracts.medicationRecordedBy 1; absent means unknown. Also accepted on the PRN take and undo of POST /api/v1/medication/bridge/prn/commands
command.missRules: miss forbids targetState, reversesEventId, rebasesCommandId, actualAt and note; baseVersion is the pending state version (0 for an untouched occurrence)

inventoryCommand.initialStock: signed 32-bit integer; start only. Send exactly one of initialStock and initialQuantity
inventoryCommand.amount: positive 32-bit integer; refill only. Send exactly one of amount and refillQuantity
inventoryCommand.refillQuantity: positive canonical exact decimal; refill only
inventoryCommand.targetStock: signed 32-bit integer; correct only. Send exactly one of targetStock and targetQuantity
inventoryCommand.stockUnit: unit the quantity is counted in; start and correct only, required for a fractional quantity

authority: accepted only while the deployment ledger is active; permanent matching receipts replay before occurrence lookup; a miss is accepted only for an exact, expected, scheduled, non-superseded occurrence whose planned time has passed on the server clock
invariants: Never retarget a missing, superseded, or identity-mismatched occurrence.
Require the exact occurrence state version as the command base.
Persist occurrence events and inventory deltas in one tenant transaction.
Allow negative tracked stock; never clamp or infer acknowledgement from equal stock.
Same-state corrections are permanent audited commands.
Inventory start appends an opening event (including a zero opening); refill and correction append signed deltas before updating the stock projection.
A miss never coerces into a correction: from any non-pending state it is refused with 409 CONFLICT_STALE_UPDATE.
A take from missed is a correct (missed to taken, delta -1); a skip from missed is a correct (delta 0); neither is a miss.
Undo reverses the current head only: undo of a miss returns pending, undo of a take-from-missed returns missed and restores the unit.
The command id of an automatic miss is derived from owner, workspace and occurrence key, so two devices replay one receipt.
recordedByCapability: contracts.medicationRecordedBy = 1 (server migration 0030). A server without it refuses the field as unknown; the client then sends none and keeps the name on the device.
capability: contracts.medicationCommands = 3 (additive recordedMiss: true). A client that only speaks 2 must report update required and stop syncing, because it cannot store the miss action or the missed state.

errors.MISS_NOT_ALLOWED: 422: the occurrence is PRN, legacy, estimated, superseded, unexpected or not yet due
errors.CONFLICT_STALE_UPDATE: 409: the occurrence is no longer pending (the person or another device recorded it first); the client discards its automatic miss

states.events: occurrence_events.action in take|skip|undo|correct|miss; from/to states in pending|taken|skipped|missed
